selection: Case-insensitive lexicographically first complete64-file capture stream, slow tempo: acoustic_mic/slow. Selection uses metadata only, before any algorithm score.
primary_metric: Exact duration accuracy using existing mir_eval.majmin-compatible evaluator; same unsupported-label/gap exclusions. Report coverage for all selected recordings.
secondary_metrics: Chord-only duration accuracy excluding reference N, to distinguish no-chord coverage from chord labelling
malformed_data: Resolve annotation format and timing from official metadata before scoring; document exclusions without observing method output.
decision: One comparison only; no new settings selected from these scores. Candidate failed development adoption threshold, so original default remains regardless of external outcome.
scope: A new recording corpus, one capture stream and tempo; do not claim64independent progression families without checking their structure.
annotation_policy: Hold each explicit mapped symbol until the next annotated beat/change; score only between first and last annotated beat. Parse final three rows as metadata. Interpret NC as N; nonstandard or malformed symbols as X. Validate slash bass syntax; major/minor metric ignores inversion.
